title: Deeper/broader renderer and kernel ACIS evidence screen
mode: primary-source repository-document review with a generated local fast test
scope: Screen ACIS claims from renderers and downstream kernel adapters
Separate raw carrier, parser, edge/mesh projection, B-rep semantics, and native acceptance
Close the planned generated NOD graph-edge/no-edge control pair for raw proxies
Keep external semantic J gates and validation cadence unchanged

localFilesInspected: DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md: ACIS evidence gates, PAR-49/7G, previous peer-provenance reviews
method.limitations: Peer findings are repository documentation and self-test descriptions, not independently reproduced behavior. ACadRust and pid-cad share codec lineage; renderer output and same-codec round trips are not independent semantic evidence. No external CAD application or ACIS kernel ran.

sources.observed: The repository-controlled note describes a tagged SAB scanner and a tagless sequential fallback, then describes extracting edge endpoints. This establishes only what the note claims about a renderer path; it does not establish full B-rep closure or analytic validity.

The ACIS path is documented as kernel lifting with direct per-surface fallback sampling when a face is not expressible in the kernel. Its resulting render mesh is therefore a display/projection result with fallback behavior, not an exact-solid oracle.

The test creates a cube from explicit vertices/faces, writes AC1032 DWG, reloads it with the same codec, and checks ACIS data presence. It is a useful generated model shape and same-codec transport regression, not independent semantic validation.

localCrossCheck.acisEvidence: The plan already separates carrier bytes, AcDs association, ACIS parse completeness, shape semantics, and native consumer acceptance. The new screen sharpens labels: edge-only projections are PROJECTION_ONLY; fallback meshes are RENDERED_OR_TESSELLATED; only independent, complete, analytically checked geometry may be SHAPE_VALIDATED.
localCrossCheck.graphTest: The existing generated ASCII/Binary test covered strict refusal for an NOD edge to a raw proxy and tolerant edge omission with raw proxy preservation. The new no-edge case strictly exports and reopens the same raw proxy without manufacturing a NOD entry.
localCrossCheck.validation: Built libdxfrw_dxf_fixture_tests and lc3_compat_check; ran the fixture executable and owning libdxfrw_dxf_fixtures CTest; git diff --check passed. No full suite was run.

evidenceLanes: opaque carrier retention and exact association
closed B-rep topology and analytic measures
assessment.lineageRule: A same-codec round-trip is a regression test, not an independent reader vote. Downstream renderers that share the codec or use fallback sampling cannot promote semantic support.
assessment.speedRule: Use the already-owned focused generated selectors at the touched slice; keep kernels and native consumer runs at the composed checkpoint.
assessment.graphRule: For the raw-proxy NOD route, test the unsupported carrier both referenced and unreferenced; with a reference, strict mode refuses before publication and tolerant mode removes the edge while preserving the carrier.
